packageRules.description: Group dependency bumps so pixi.lock is regenerated once, and keep the pre-commit hook revisions in step with the pyproject ranges
Changing the supported Python version is a project decision, not a routine bump. Covers both requires-python and the pixi python pin
The commitlint CLI, its config and the pre-commit hook enforce the same rules, so they have to move together. The hook bundles its own CLI, so its rev belongs here rather than in the pixi group

customManagers.description: The pre-commit manager only tracks a hook repo's rev, not its additional_dependencies, so pick up the commitlint config pinned there as well
